title: tkr native animation clip document (contract animation-clip, version 1.0.0-pre.1)
description: A native animation clip: an ordered list of frames shown one after another at one delay, on one canvas (docs/spec/formats/native-animation-clip.md). This schema describes version 1.0.0-pre.1 of the animation-clip contract only. The contract is pre-release and free to change; once published, a new optional property is a minor change and a break is a major one (docs/spec/formats/native-contracts.md#versions). It validates the derived JSON form of a document: the authored YAML is read into the same values first. The top level is closed to the stamp, the clip's own fields and exactly one open key, pluginData, whose envelope (plugin id, version, data is a mapping) it checks and whose data it leaves open (docs/spec/formats/native-contracts.md#plugin-blocks). It cannot check key order (contract and version come first), repeated keys (including a repeated plugin id), that a reference names a file that exists, or that the optional tags and metadata hold no timestamps; the spec page says which check owns each of those.

contract.description: The stamp's contract name (native-contracts.md#stamp). Always animation-clip for this contract.

version.description: The stamp's contract version, written against this schema (native-contracts.md#versions). Text, never a number. The first pattern is the form MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH[-pre.N][+build]: all three numbers always written with no leading zeros, a dotted pre-release, and a build suffix of dot-separated letters, digits and hyphens. The second pins this contract's version, 1.0.0-pre.1; a build suffix after + is debug evidence only and does not change the version.

tags.description: Optional free-form labels for people and tools, such as imported. The engine never reads them and they never change how a clip plays.

metadata.description: Optional facts about where the document came from, such as the source file it was imported from. The engine never reads anything in it. It holds no timestamps and no value that changes on every save. Its keys are free-form until the standard keys are ruled.

canvas.description: The box each frame is drawn into, in pixels. A picture is sampled whole at its own size and fills the canvas; the canvas never picks which part of a picture is read.

delay.description: Seconds between one frame being shown and the next, the same for every frame. Zero is allowed because legacy files carry it; what playback does with zero is an open item.

colourKey.description: Optional. The colour that counts as see-through in a frame, unless that frame names its own. Absent means the clip names no colour key.

frames.description: The frames, in the order they are shown. There is no fixed count: the list holds only real frames, and at least one.

pluginData.description: Optional. The one open key of the contract: one block per plugin, keyed by plugin id (docs/spec/formats/native-contracts.md#plugin-blocks). A plugin id is lowercase ASCII segments separated by dots, or one segment, as PKG-2 spells it (docs/spec/engine/rpgcode-modules-and-objects.md#pkg-2); it is never a reserved top-level key or a field of this contract. The schema checks only the envelope. What is inside a block's data belongs to the plugin and is checked by the plugin's own schema, only when the plugin is installed.

pluginBlock.description: One plugin's block: the version of that plugin's data on this contract, and the data, which the plugin owns. The envelope is closed to these two keys. Unknown keys inside data are tolerated, so data has no property list and no additionalProperties rule.

version.description: The version of this plugin's data on this contract, in the form MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH[-pre.N][+build] (docs/spec/formats/native-contracts.md#versions). Text, never a number.

data.description: The plugin's data, a mapping that may be empty.

reference.description: The ID of a project asset: its path, compared without regard to ASCII case (native-contracts.md#identity). One non-empty line with no space at either end. Whether the file exists is a check made elsewhere.

colour.description: A colour as red, green and blue, each a whole number from 0 to 255. There is no alpha.

frame.description: One frame: the picture to show and, optionally, the sound that plays when it appears and a colour key of its own.

image.description: The picture: the ID of an image asset, or a tile reference (formats/README.md#tile-references) spelled with the tileset's ID. A frame must name one.

sound.description: Optional. The ID of a sound asset played once when this frame is shown. Absent means no sound.

colourKey.description: Optional. This frame's own colour key; it wins over the clip's.
